items.name: react/css/default-video
items.title: Default Video Skin (React, CSS)
items.description: A video skin with play, seek, current and remaining time, volume, fullscreen, tooltips, and thumbnail previews. React source with vanilla CSS.

items.name: react/css/fullscreen-button
items.title: Fullscreen Button (React, CSS)
items.description: A button that enters and exits fullscreen with state-aware icons and an accessible tooltip. React source with vanilla CSS.

items.name: react/css/play-button
items.title: Play Button (React, CSS)
items.description: A three-state button that plays, pauses, or restarts media with matching icons and an accessible tooltip. React source with vanilla CSS.

items.name: react/css/seek-button
items.title: Seek Button (React, CSS)
items.description: A button that skips playback forward or backward by a configurable number of seconds, with a direction-aware icon and accessible tooltip. React source with vanilla CSS.

items.name: react/css/time-slider
items.title: Time Slider (React, CSS)
items.description: A playback timeline for seeking, with current and buffered progress plus time and thumbnail previews. React source with vanilla CSS.

items.name: react/css/volume-popover
items.title: Volume Control (React, CSS)
items.description: A mute toggle with a vertical slider for adjusting playback volume in a popover. React source with vanilla CSS.

items.name: react/css/volume-slider
items.title: Volume Slider (React, CSS)
items.description: A horizontal or vertical slider for adjusting playback volume by dragging, using the keyboard, or scrolling. React source with vanilla CSS.
